sprache.name: English
app.beschreibung: A presentation editor on reveal.js, usable by people who do not want to write Markdown — and it still stores nothing but Markdown.
app.kurz: A presentation editor on reveal.js that stores nothing but Markdown.
uebersicht.leer: No talk yet. The box below creates the first one.
dialog.hinweis: The title goes on the first slide and can be changed at any time.
editor.textPlatzhalter: Write the text of the slide here.
editor.quelltextHinweis: This slide holds Markdown the formatting buttons cannot express (a table or code, say). It is therefore edited as source.
editor.bildKeine: No images in this talk yet.
editor.vorschauHinweis: This is the slide as it looks on the wall.
editor.exportHtml: A single HTML file (runs without anything)
editor.exportPdf: PDF to hand out (takes a moment)
farbe.ohne: Like the rest of the talk
werkzeug.fragmentTip: Show this paragraph only on a click
karte.ausruecken: Make it stand on its own again
meldung.mindestensEine: A talk needs at least one slide.
meldung.bleibtQuelltext: This slide holds Markdown the buttons cannot express. It stays as source.
meldung.bildFehler: The image could not be uploaded.
layout.titel.label: Title slide
layout.titel.hilfe: Large title, subtitle or speaker below. For the opening.
layout.abschnitt.label: Section
layout.abschnitt.hilfe: Divider between two topics. Coloured background, title only.
layout.text.label: Text
layout.text.hilfe: Heading and body. The common case.
layout.spalten.label: Two columns
layout.spalten.hilfe: Like text, but the body runs in two columns side by side.
layout.bild-rechts.label: Image right
layout.bild-rechts.hilfe: Text on the left, image beside it on the right.
layout.bild-links.label: Image left
layout.bild-links.hilfe: Image on the left, text beside it on the right.
layout.bild-voll.label: Full-bleed image
layout.bild-voll.hilfe: Image across the whole slide, text readable on top.
layout.zitat.label: Quote
server.serverfehler: Something went wrong on the server.
server.pdfKeinBrowser: There is no browser on the server to produce a PDF with. Install Chromium or Chrome (the Dockerfile does that inside the container), or set the path in BROWSER_PATH.
server.pdfFehler: The PDF could not be produced. The details are in the server log.
server.pdfVonHand: Until then it also works by hand: open the slides in print format and choose „Save as PDF“ in the browser's print dialog.
